Two men stand frozen in a stiff arms-down pose at the fish shop, one barefoot and one in shoes (step-094 of the 17:15 walk). The same stiff stance shows on the woman at Mickey's door (step-032 and step-063 of the 17:15 walk) and on the man pressed to the wall at night (step-125 of the 17:15 walk).

**Visual faults:** a tall white slab floats in the fog above the rooftops (step-032 of the 17:15 walk). A blank white board stands in front of Rita's window, with no sign or texture (step-037 of the 17:28 walk).

**Night is dead and badly lit:** the player is lit flat orange-yellow, as if by a floodlight, on an empty dark street with nobody about (step-156 of the 17:15 walk; step-099 of the 17:28 walk). The street then goes almost fully black (step-130 of the 17:28 walk).

**The town's named people are missing:** the record never reaches Sheila, Ron or Darren. Two are "not on the street" and the walk loses sight of the third, so there were no greetings and no conversation (0 replies).
**No one reacts:** at 3 a.m. one onlooker line fires, but nobody saw the deed, the police were told by no one, and figures stand idle as the player passes close by (step-125 of the 17:15 walk).
